text:
sarah_sales: Hey team — Acme wants a Dedicated POC with static egress IPs and a clear rotation/onboarding plan. Need confirmation on steps, timeline, and whether we can waive infra surcharge for a 30d trial. cc @james_se @leo_netops @anya_security @acme_sre

james_se: Quick clarifying Q — do they require our Dedicated pool traffic to present from fixed IPv4s to their downstream APIs?

acme_sre: yes, we need two fixed IPv4s so we can allowlist and still have an option to rotate temporarily for key rollouts.

leo_netops: We have two options: 1) allocate static EIP(s) per dedicated endpoint (recommended) or 2) route via our shared egress proxy (IPs rotate, e.g., every 24h). Static EIP requires reserved capacity + EIP allocation.

sarah_sales: How does choosing static EIPs affect pricing? Customer asked whether static IPs cost extra.

james_se: Static EIP + Dedicated pool carries a small infra surcharge. For a short POC (30d) we can discuss waiving the infra surcharge if customer commits to production within 90d. I'll confirm with pricing ops and update.

anya_security: One security note — confirm whether they want TLS only or mTLS. For static IPs we terminate TLS at our ingress; mTLS is supported on Dedicated endpoints if they supply client certs.

acme_sre: mTLS preferred. We'll provide certs and plan to rotate monthly.

leo_netops: mTLS is fine. We'll need the cert chain and SANs. For cert rotation we suggest a rolling overlap window of 7 days to avoid outages.

deploy-bot: [provisioning] Dedicated-poc: creating endpoint request id `ded-poc-1951`. ETA ~45m.

james_se: For allowlisting we need two things from Acme: 1) source CIDRs or single IPs to allow, 2) maintenance windows for any change requests.

acme_sre: We'll provide two /32s: `203.0.113.45` and `203.0.113.46`. Preferred change window: 09:00-17:00 UTC Mon-Fri.

leo_netops: Got it. We'll author firewall rules for those source IPs and configure egress NAT so outbound traffic maps to our static EIPs. Do you need reverse DNS for the EIPs?

acme_sre: No reverse DNS needed.

sarah_sales: Operationally — do we need an internal ticket or can they just reply in this thread with IPs + cert?

james_se: Ticket preferred for audit and tracking. I'll open a JIRA and tag @leo_netops and @anya_security.

anya_security: Also need confirmation on data residency and log access. For Dedicated POC logs are retained for 30 days by default. If they need SIEM forwarding or longer retention that's an add-on.

acme_sre: 30 days retention is fine for the POC. For production we'll look at SIEM forwarding.

leo_netops: Action items for NetOps: allocate two EIPs, configure NAT mapping, enable mTLS on the endpoint, update ACLs, and document rotation process.

james_se: QA needs to run smoke tests — can Acme share a test endpoint and short-lived test token? We'll validate from the dedicated endpoint once NAT/EIP is configured.

acme_sre: Test endpoint: `https://api.acme.example/v1/ingest`. Test token: `poc-token-abc`. We'll rotate after POC.

sarah_sales: Target timeline: request submitted today -> customer shares certs + IPs -> netops runs config -> smoke tests -> go-live. Aim for 48-72 hours end-to-end.

leo_netops: Realistic ETA: Day 1 allocate EIPs + NAT config, Day 2 install mTLS certs & validation, then smoke tests. I'll post updates in this thread when endpoint is reachable.

deploy-bot: [status] dedicated-poc `ded-poc-1951` moved to IN_PROGRESS.

james_se: For the security questionnaire we'll confirm SOC2 status, KMS integration (we support customer-managed keys via KMS), and data at-rest/in-transit details.

anya_security: I'll draft the SQ answers and attach them to the JIRA.

acme_sre: One more ask: during the POC we might request an additional temporary IP for weekend failover. Possible?

leo_netops: We can issue ephemeral extra IPs for short windows. Please open a ticket with requested times; we recommend 4h lead time for provisioning.

sarah_sales: James — can you confirm the waived infra surcharge for a 30-day POC if they sign for production within 90 days?

james_se: I'll confirm with pricing ops and put the answer in the JIRA. Tentatively yes, but will confirm.

acme_sre: Thanks all. We'll upload certs to the ticket and confirm the IPs in ~30m.

sarah_sales: Perfect — thanks team :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: [update] dedicated-poc `ded-poc-1951` status: READY_FOR_NETOPS.

leo_netops: Starting NAT/EIP steps now. I'll post smoke test results when done.
